diagnostics.message: `module.runners:resource.aws_sqs_queue_policy.build_queue_dlq_policy` is the TLS-only policy for the dead-letter queue, but it sets `queue_url = aws_sqs_queue.queued_builds.id`, so it never depends on (and never attaches to) `module.runners:resource.aws_sqs_queue.queued_builds_dlq`. When `redrive_build_queue.enabled` is true, the DLQ is created with no queue policy, while the main build queue ends up with two competing `aws_sqs_queue_policy` resources (this one and `build_queue_policy`), so the two policies overwrite each other depending on apply order. Point `queue_url` at the DLQ so the DLQ exists before its policy is attached and the redrive target is actually secured.
